name: use-controllable-state
title: Use Controllable State
description: State that a parent may control: it follows `value` when one is given and keeps its own from `defaultValue` when not, calling `onChange` either way.

meta.when: Writing a component that should work both controlled (`value` + `onValueChange`) and uncontrolled (`defaultValue`), which every input-like component in the library does. Radix primitives already do this for their own state; use this for state the library adds on top.
